description: This PHP test class `LeaveEntitlementDaoGetLeaveBalanceTest` tests the `LeaveEntitlementDao`'s `getLeaveBalance()` method. It covers various scenarios for calculating leave balances, including date ranges, unlinked leave, multiple entitlements, and edge cases. The class uses mocks extensively to simulate external service behavior.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoGetLeaveBalanceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the correctness of leave balance calculations by `LeaveEntitlementDao` for various date ranges and leave scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating a new instance of `LeaveEntitlementDao`, setting up fixture data, and populating the database.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalance
methods.description: Performs extensive testing of the `getLeaveBalance()` method over multiple scenarios such as pre-start, start, between, end, after, with date ranges, multiple entitlements, and no entitlements.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Tests leave balance calculation with unlinked leave within specified date ranges.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeaveWhenAfterPeriod
methods.description: Tests leave balance when excluding unlinked leave after the specified period.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedBeforePeriod
methods.description: Tests leave balance when excluding unlinked leave before the specified period.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Tests leave balance calculation when unlinked leave is explicitly set to null.
